name: Team Outlook
description: Create a current team outlook from a required sport followed by a team, for example /team_outlook baseball Los Angeles Dodgers, /team_outlook football Seattle Seahawks, or /team_outlook soccer Portland Timbers. Google Sports resolves the team once, then direct team standings and roster calls preserve focused division or conference context even when the full league exceeds the result bound; Google News Light adds optional current storylines. Jarvis translates football to SerpApi American football and soccer to SerpApi association football.
